34:     def combine_precipitation_timesteps(self) -> xr.Dataset:
35:         """
36:         Read and write out all precipitation timesteps into one precipitation data
37: 
38:         Returns
39:         -------
40:         combined_precipitation_timestep : xr.Dataset
41:             Precipitation that combines all timesteps
42:         """
43:         log.info("Combining precipitation timesteps")
44:         # Collect all files of precipitation timesteps
45:         precipitation_timesteps_files = self.collect_precipitation_timesteps()
46: 
47:         # Read/combine all files of precipitation timesteps
48:         combined_precipitation_timesteps = xr.open_mfdataset(
49:             precipitation_timesteps_files,
50:             combine='nested',
51:             concat_dim='time'
52:         )
53: 
54:         # Change variable name from rainfall_depth to depth
55:         combined_precipitation_timesteps = combined_precipitation_timesteps.rename({
56:             "rainfall_depth": "depth"
57:         })
58: 
59:         # remove spatial_ref (important)
60:         if "spatial_ref" in combined_precipitation_timesteps:
61:             combined_precipitation_timesteps = combined_precipitation_timesteps.drop_vars("spatial_ref")
62: 
63:         # Add necessary attribute
64:         combined_precipitation_timesteps.attrs["Conventions"] = "CF-1.5"
65: 
66:         return combined_precipitation_timesteps
